questions.question: In which city was the 114th International Labour Conference (ILC) held in June 2026, where the Indian delegation was led by Union Minister of State Shobha Karandlaje?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Geneva, Switzerland**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__

• Union Minister of State for Labour and Employment, **Sushri Shobha Karandlaje**, led the Indian delegation at the **114th International Labour Conference (ILC)** held in **Geneva, Switzerland** on **9th June 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__

• The **114th International Labour Conference** took place in **Geneva, Switzerland**, where India underlined its commitment to **inclusive growth**, **gender equality**, and **social dialogue**.

• During the conference, the Indian delegation engaged in high-level **bilateral meetings** with representatives from **Nepal**, **Angola**, and **Mauritius** to discuss labour welfare and digital technology.

• The Indian delegation highlighted that **Nepal** remains a priority partner under India's **Neighbourhood First policy**, focusing on **skill development** and **labour mobility**.

• India offered **technical assistance** and **capacity building** to **Angola** for developing digital platforms for **employment services** and **worker registration**.

• **Mauritius** appreciated India's progress in **Digital Public Infrastructure** in the labour and employment sector, with India reaffirming its readiness to share expertise.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Sushri Shobha Karandlaje** also held discussions with labour ministers from **France**, the **UK**, **South Korea**, the **USA**, and **Canada**.

• The discussions with these nations focused on **legal pathways** for the migration of **skilled manpower** from India.

• Key topics included the **mutual recognition of skills** and **demand-driven skilling** to facilitate global workforce mobility.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The **International Labour Conference** is a key global forum held annually in **Geneva** to set international labour standards.

• India's participation emphasized its role as a provider of **digital goods** and **technical expertise** to partner nations in the **Global South**.

• The **114th ILC** served as a platform to deepen **fraternal ties** and ensure the **welfare of workers** across borders.
</ul

questions.question: According to the announcement made by the Union Health Ministry in June 2026, more than how many health records have been linked under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM)?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**100 crore**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• Union Health Minister **Shri J.P. Nadda** launched **Aarogya Setu 2.0** and several other digital health initiatives on **29 June 2026**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• During the launch event, it was highlighted that India has built one of the world's largest digital health ecosystems with **more than 100 crore health records linked**.
• The Minister also noted that over **90 crore ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account)** accounts have been created to date.
• The digital initiatives, including the revamped **Aarogya Setu 2.0**, aim to make healthcare more **integrated, accessible, and citizen-centric**.
• These initiatives are designed to cater to all age groups, including mothers, children, the youth, and the elderly, providing a single integrated platform for fragmented health services.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• The list of digital initiatives launched includes **Ayushman App**, **Ayushman Sarathi WhatsApp Chatbot**, **National Health Claims Exchange (NHCX)**, and **e-Sushrut Clinic**.
• Technical layers such as **Bharat Health Terminology Service (BHTS)** and **Common LOINC Codes for India (CLCI)** were also introduced.
• AI-enabled initiatives like **SAHI** and **BODHI** have been launched to support better healthcare delivery through **Artificial Intelligence**.
• The initiatives were developed under the aegis of the **National Health Authority (NHA)** and the **National Resource Centre for EHR Standards (NRCeS)**.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The Government has adopted a **whole-of-government approach** to integrate **AYUSH** systems with modern healthcare.
• The initiative aligns with the vision of **Viksit Bharat@2047**, aiming for a digitally empowered and healthier India.
• While the Union Government provides the digital infrastructure, **effective implementation remains a State subject** as per the constitutional framework.</ul

questions.question: As per the revised guidelines issued by the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** in **June 2026**, what is one of the primary objectives of the overhauled **Lead Bank Scheme (LBS)**?

options.text: Enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors for inclusive growth
Automating the credit appraisal process for large corporate borrowers
Phasing out the role of Lead District Managers in rural areas
Establishing a centralized tax collection system for rural businesses

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors for inclusive growth**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** has overhauled the **Lead Bank Scheme (LBS)** through revised guidelines issued on **June 19, 2026**, following a comprehensive review of the scheme.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• The **RBI** stated that the revamped **Lead Bank Scheme** seeks to achieve two key objectives: **enhancing the flow of credit to priority sectors** for achieving inclusive growth and **deepening financial inclusion** through improved access and usage of financial services.
• Under the new framework, a **Lead Bank** in every district will coordinate the efforts of banks, government agencies, and other institutions to improve credit flow and promote **financial inclusion**.
• The revised guidelines mandate every **Lead Bank** to appoint a **Lead District Manager (LDM)** to exclusively oversee and coordinate the scheme's implementation in the district.
• A **three-tier structure** comprising **Block Level Bankers' Committees**, **District Consultative Committees**, and **State Level Bankers' Committees (SLBCs)** has been introduced to strengthen coordination.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• The **Lead Bank Scheme** was originally introduced by the **RBI** in **December 1969**.
• Historically, the scheme has played a vital role in **branch expansion**, **deposit mobilisation**, and lending in **rural** and **semi-urban** regions across India.
• The **2026 guidelines** supersede all earlier instructions issued by the **Reserve Bank of India** regarding the **LBS**.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The **District-level committees** are tasked with preparing and reviewing **District Credit Plans** and resolving operational issues related to implementation.
• The review process for these new guidelines included examining **public feedback** received on a draft framework released earlier in the year.</ul

questions.question: According to the Supreme Court judgment delivered in June 2026, which of the following has been recognized as a fundamental right that overrides the privilege of a motor vehicle?

options.text: The right to free use of national highways by cyclists
The right to walk on demarcated footpaths
The right to zero-emission public transportation
The right to emergency medical care on highways

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The right to walk on demarcated footpaths**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• The **Supreme Court** of India has recognized **walking on demarcated footpaths** as a **fundamental right** that shall override the privilege of a motor vehicle.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• A bench of **Justices P S Narasimha** and **Atul S Chandurkar** declared that the **fundamental right to walk** on demarcated footpaths alongside motorised roads is now recognized, urging the government to introduce a law to enforce it.
• The court observed that the **Motor Vehicles Act, 1988**, has historically focused on the "vehicle" as the subject, while human interests like pedestrian safety were treated as incidental.
• The judgment highlighted that **pedestrian deaths** in India surged by nearly **163%** (or 2.63 times) between **2015 and 2024**, rising from **13,894** to **36,526**.
• The other options like the right to cycle, zero-emission transport, or emergency care on highways were not the focus of this specific landmark ruling regarding fundamental rights on footpaths.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• Pedestrians now account for the **second-highest share** of road fatalities in India after **two-wheeler users**.
• The share of pedestrians in total road fatalities more than doubled from **9.5% in 2015** to **20.61% in 2024**.
• The **Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)** had notified the **Motor Vehicles (Driving) Regulations** in 2017, but the court noted these are only guiding principles and do not prioritize pedestrian rights over motorized roads.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The case originated from the death of a **5-year-old boy** struck by a tanker; the Supreme Court recalculated the compensation to **Rs. 11.44 lakh** to be paid to the father.
• The court stated that violation of this right will now allow citizens to invoke **constitutional and legal remedies** beyond the **Motor Vehicles Act**.</ul

questions.question: Which state has emerged as the leader in the digitisation of enumeration forms during the third phase of the **Special Intensive Revision (SIR)** of electoral rolls, according to officials in June 2026?
questions.solution:

__
 
• **Mizoram** emerged as the leader among **16 states and 3 union territories** by completing **68.05%** of the digitisation process.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

questions.question: Which of the following agricultural products from **Madhya Pradesh** were recently awarded the **Geographical Indication (GI)** tag in June 2026?

questions.question: Which country officially became the 10th member of the New Development Bank (NDB) and the first from the Central Asian region in June 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Uzbekistan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Republic of Uzbekistan** has officially joined the **New Development Bank (NDB)** as a shareholder, effective from **June 5, 2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Uzbekistan** has become the **10th member** of the NDB and is the **first country from Central Asia** to join the institution.
 
• The membership became effective after the country ratified the **NDB Articles of Agreement** and fulfilled all necessary requirements on **June 5, 2026**.
 
• Uzbek President **Shavkat Mirziyoyev** signed the law for accession on **May 21**, aiming to expand trade, economic, and investment cooperation.
 
• The NDB plans to explore investment projects in Uzbekistan later this year, focusing on **energy, water management, transport, and municipal infrastructure**.
 
• Between 2023 and 2025, Uzbekistan's economy showed strong performance with an **average annual growth of more than 6.7 per cent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **New Development Bank (NDB)** was established in **2015** by the **BRICS nations** (Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa).
 
• As of June 2026, the NDB has approved **139 projects** worth approximately **US $43 billion**.
 
• Beyond the founding BRICS members, the bank now includes **Egypt, the UAE, Bangladesh, Algeria, and Uzbekistan**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The NDB intends to use its strengths such as **financing in national currencies** and applying **national procurement procedures** for its operations in Uzbekistan.
 
• **Andrey Bokarev**, Director General of the **NDB Eurasian Regional Centre**, noted that Central Asia is one of the world's most dynamically developing regions.

Financial disbursement of **₹15,200 crore** to **8.65 crore** farmers and establishment of **290 natural farming clusters** covering **14,800 hectares**.

questions.question: According to the proceedings of the National Conference held in June 2026, what unique distinction does the **Indian Pharmacopoeia (IP) 2026** hold regarding transfusion services?

questions.question: Under which article of the **Paris Agreement** did **India** and **Japan** adopt the **'Rule of Implementation'** for the **Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM)** in June 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Article 6.2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Government of the Republic of India** and the **Government of Japan** adopted the **'Rule of Implementation'** of the **Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM)** on **08.06.2026**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The adoption took place under **Article 6.2** of the **Paris Agreement** of the **United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC)**.
 
• The **Rule of Implementation** establishes a robust **governance framework**, which includes a **Joint Committee** consisting of representatives from both the Indian and Japanese governments.
 
• This mechanism is designed to facilitate **mitigation activities** that result in the reduction or removal of **greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions** while promoting **sustainable development** in India.
 
• It includes procedures for **transparent project approval**, **third-party validation and verification**, and **national registries** to track the issuance and transfer of credits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• India and Japan had previously signed a **Memorandum of Cooperation (MoC)** for the **Joint Crediting Mechanism (JCM)** last year to set the foundation for this collaboration.
 
• The JCM is intended to contribute significantly to the **Nationally Determined Contributions (NDCs)** of both countries, aligning with global climate goals.
 
• The mechanism will encourage **technology transfer**, **investment**, and **capacity-building** for projects focusing on **low-carbon technologies**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• The **Joint Crediting Mechanism** demonstrates **India’s** commitment to **climate action** and international cooperation.
 
• It ensures **sustainable development safeguards** are in place for all projects involving emission reductions.

questions.question: In June 2026, which organization collaborated with the Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (OPSA) to launch the **TRL Compass Platform** for standardising Technology Readiness Level assessments across sectors?

options.text: National Association of Software and Service Companies (NASSCOM)

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Data Security Council of India (DSCI)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• On **29 June 2026**, the **Office of the Principal Scientific Adviser (OPSA)** to the Government of India, in collaboration with the **Data Security Council of India (DSCI)**, launched the **TRL Compass Platform**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **TRL Compass Platform**: It is designed to standardise **Technology Readiness Level (TRL)** assessments across various sectors by adapting the globally accepted **nine-level TRL scale** to the specific needs of India's research and innovation ecosystem.
• **Data Security Council of India (DSCI)**: This is the primary organization that collaborated with **OPSA** for this initiative. Hence, the correct answer is **DSCI**.
• **Objective**: The platform aims to provide a common national standard for evaluating projects seeking **public funding**, moving from subjective judgment to an objective, documentation-backed assessment.
• **Chairmanship**: The launch took place under the chairmanship of **Prof. Ajay Kumar Sood**, the Principal Scientific Adviser to the GoI.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• The platform includes sector-specific annexures for **Healthcare & Pharmaceuticals** and **Software**.
• A **Memorandum of Understanding (MoU)** was signed between **Vinayak Godse (CEO, DSCI)** and **Dr. Preeti Banzal (Adviser/Scientist 'G', OPSA)** to facilitate collaboration on technology readiness assessments and capability mapping.
• The partnership will also focus on building a pool of **trained assessors** for TRL assessments across India.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• **TRL Compass** will support the implementation of national initiatives such as the **Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF)** and the **Research, Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund**.
• The framework is openly available to researchers and funding agencies at **www.trlcompass.in**.
• It is a key step toward the **Viksit Bharat 2047** vision by facilitating the translation of research into deployable and commercially viable technologies.</ul

questions.question: Under the revised 7x7x7 framework of the **Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan** released in June 2026, which of the following has been added as the **seventh beneficiary group**?

options.text: Women in the menopausal age group

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Low Birth Weight (LBW) babies (0–6 months)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare, **Shri J.P. Nadda**, released the **Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Operational Guidelines** during the **16th Meeting** of the **Central Council of Health and Family Welfare (CCHFW)** in New Delhi on **29th June 2026**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• The revised guidelines mark the transition from **Anemia Mukt Bharat** to **Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan**, evolving the program's focus from **prophylactic care** to **therapeutic care**.
• The existing **6x6x6 strategy** has been expanded into a **7x7x7 framework**, which introduces a new seventh component across beneficiaries, interventions, and institutional mechanisms.
• **Low Birth Weight (LBW) babies (0–6 months)** have been officially included as the **seventh beneficiary group** to break the intergenerational cycle of anemia at the earliest possible stage.
• The other options like adolescent boys, menopausal women, or senior citizens are not mentioned as the specific seventh addition in the revised framework provided in the news content.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• The **7th intervention** introduced is the **"Eating Right"** approach, promoting the daily consumption of iron-rich and diversified diets.
• The **7th institutional mechanism** is a **strengthened Monitoring and Evaluation framework** for digital tracking of anemia services.
• The program has shifted from the **T3 approach (Test, Treat, Talk)** to the **T4 approach (Test, Treat, Talk, Track)** to ensure better follow-up and continuum of care.
• A unified **Anemia Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan Portal** will now converge records from the **JANANI**, **RBSK**, and **U-WIN** portals for comprehensive digital tracking.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• For severe anemia cases among **pregnant and lactating women**, **Intravenous Iron Therapy** (FCM and Iron sucrose) is included as a clinical intervention.
• The **'Jan Bhagidari'** initiative aims to transform anemia management into a nationwide community mobilization effort.
• The overarching goal is to reduce **Anemia prevalence**, improve maternal and child health, and contribute to lower **Infant Mortality Rate (IMR)** and **Maternal Mortality Ratio (MMR)**.

questions.question: In June 2026, a team of researchers discovered a new species of pollution-eating bacteria in the waters of the Hooghly river that can break down toxic industrial chemicals. What is the name of this newly identified microbe?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Brachybacterium netajii**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• A team of researchers from India and Japan discovered a new species of bacteria, **Brachybacterium netajii**, in the **Hooghly river** (West Bengal) that possesses the ability to break down toxic chemicals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Discovery:** The microbe was isolated from the Hooghly region of the **Ganges** using an enrichment culture technique where **p-nitrophenol (PNP)**, a toxic industrial chemical, was the only food source.
 
• **Characteristics:** The bacterium is **halotolerant**, meaning it can survive in salty environments containing up to **9% salt**. It also shows resilience against heavy metals like **arsenic, cadmium, lead, and mercury**.
 
• **Naming:** It was named **Brachybacterium netajii** as a tribute to **Subhas Chandra Bose** (Netaji), honoring his legacy of scientific and technological self-reliance.
 
• **Unique Traits:** Polyphasic taxonomic characterisation revealed unique fatty acids (**C11:0 and C10:0 2-OH**) and **genomic islands** that help produce industrial enzymes and protective compounds like **ectoine**.
 
• **Comparison with Options:** Options like **Brachybacterium hooghlyensis**, **Brachybacterium gangesii**, and **Brachybacterium bengalensis** are plausible but incorrect names not mentioned in the research; the specific scientific name assigned is **Brachybacterium netajii**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The research team involved scientists from **Netaji Mahavidyalaya**, **University of Burdwan**, **Indian Institute of Technology (BHU)**, and **Hiroshima University** in Japan.
 
• The bacterium's genetic toolkit can be utilized in **pharmaceutical manufacturing** and **large-scale environmental clean-ups**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **PNP degradation:** The bacteria thrived by eating **p-nitrophenol (PNP)**, which is toxic to most other organisms.
 
• **Environmental Impact:** The discovery provides an **environmentally friendly** way to tackle industrial pollution in India's waterways.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The President highlighted four critical pillars for tribal welfare: **adequate nutrition** for pregnant mothers, **education** in good schools, **dignified livelihood** for youth, and **welfare benefits** for every family.
• The conclave served as a platform for **state and project-level officials** to deliberate on constructive solutions for tribal transformation.</ul

questions.question: In which Indian city is the **University of Liverpool** set to establish its branch campus following the receipt of the **Letter of Approval (LoA)** in June 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**
__
• On **June 4, 2026**, the **Ministry of Education** handed over the **Letter of Approval (LoA)** to the **University of Liverpool**, UK, to establish its branch campus in **Bengaluru**, Karnataka.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**
__
• **Bengaluru Campus:** The **University of Liverpool** has been authorized to start its operations in **Bengaluru**, marking a major step in the internationalisation of higher education in India.
• **Official Handover:** The LoA was handed over by **Dr. Vineet Joshi**, Secretary of the Department of Higher Education and Chairman of **UGC**, to **Professor Richard Grose**, Provost of the University of Liverpool Bangalore.
• **Regulatory Path:** The university was previously granted a **Letter of Intent (LoI)** on **May 26, 2025**, under the **UGC Regulations, 2023**, before completing the necessary infrastructure and academic preparations.
• **High-Level Presence:** The event was witnessed by Union Education Minister **Shri Dharmendra Pradhan**, External Affairs Minister **Dr. S Jaishankar**, and UK Foreign Secretary **Rt. Hon. Yvette Cooper**.
• **Course Offerings:** The campus will offer **Under Graduate (UG)** and **Post Graduate (PG)** programmes in fields like **Business Management**, **Computer Science**, **Game Design**, **Finance**, and **Biomedical Sciences**.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
__
• **NEP 2020:** The establishment of this campus is a direct outcome of the **National Education Policy 2020**, which seeks to invite reputed global institutions to India to enhance **student mobility** and academic collaboration.
• **Institutional Legacy:** Established in **1881**, the **University of Liverpool** is a world-leading institution known for research and innovation.
• **India-UK Relations:** Education is considered a vital pillar of **India-UK bilateral relations**, and this campus is expected to further strengthen these ties.
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

• The university met the readiness and compliance requirements of the **UGC (Setting Up and Operation of Campuses of Foreign Higher Educational Institutions in India) Regulations, 2023**.
• The presence of the **British High Commissioner to India**, Ms. Lindy Cameron, and Foreign Secretary **Shri Vikram Misri** highlighted the strategic importance of this development.</ul

questions.question: According to the Trilateral Framework agreement signed in June 2026, what is the primary condition for the progressive redeployment of the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) out of Lebanese territory?

options.text: The immediate establishment of a unified tax platform between Israel and Lebanon
The verified disarmament of non-state armed groups and dismantlement of associated infrastructure
The deployment of 10,000 additional US ground troops to the border regions
The formal recognition of Hezbollah as a legitimate political wing of the Lebanese state

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The verified disarmament of non-state armed groups and dismantlement of associated infrastructure**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **US, Israel, and Lebanon** signed a **Trilateral Framework agreement** in Washington, DC, on **June 26, 2026**, aimed at ending months of conflict.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the agreement document, the **progressive redeployment** of the **Israel Defense Forces (IDF)** out of Lebanese territory depends on the **verified disarmament of non-state armed groups** and the **dismantlement of associated infrastructure**. Hence, the correct answer is the second option.
 
• The document specifically identifies **Hezbollah** as a **non-state armed group** in point 7.
 
• The framework outlines a **reciprocal, sequenced process** intended to allow **Lebanon’s armed forces** to eventually take control over its territory.
 
• Israeli Prime Minister **Benjamin Netanyahu** clarified that forces would not withdraw as long as **Hezbollah is not disarmed** and a threat to Israel remains.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The **US State Department** has committed **$100 million** in **humanitarian assistance** as part of the support for this framework.
 
• The agreement identified two initial **"pilot zones"** for the IDF's withdrawal and the assumption of control by Lebanese forces; Israel has reportedly withdrawn from **one** already.
 
• US Secretary of State **Marco Rubio** termed the agreement "the beginning of the beginning."

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• This agreement is **distinct** from the **Memorandum of Understanding** signed between the **US and Iran** earlier in June 2026.
 
• **Hezbollah** has officially rejected the deal, with Secretary-General **Naim Qassem** labeling the linking of withdrawal to disarmament a **"humiliation."**
 
• Since **March 2026**, Israeli strikes have killed over **4,000 people** in Lebanon.
